title: Search Mechanics
summary: improve the separate domain-owned search systems by establishing one Docs Viewer inverted-index format before expanding Studio retrieval to full text
content_html:
Search Mechanics

Refine index inclusion, ranking, result context, and efficiency while retaining the current separate Catalogue and Docs Viewer static-search structure.

Feature Documents

  • DSI-1 — Docs Viewer Search Index v2 Delivery — complete and closed; every Docs Viewer scope uses one inverted-index structure and one browser query path.
  • DSI-2 — Scope-Level Sub-Scope Search Delivery — proposed; include eligible documents from visibly hosted sub-scopes in one scope-level index with exact collection navigation and compact context.
  • SM-1 — Studio Full-Text Search Delivery — complete and closed; Studio searches authored headings, prose, and code while structural identity, update, and parent context remain non-searchable.
  • SM-2 — Docs Viewer Search Relevance Delivery — proposed; establish one bounded corpus-adaptive relevance policy for Docs Viewer full-text scopes, using Studio first and Analysis when its public corpus is ready.
  • Studio Full-Text Search Index Concept — retained design and prototype record.
  • Docs Viewer Search Tokenizer Concept — retained term-semantics proposal and reasoning.
  • Search — current architecture and known weak spots.

Studio Documentation Maintenance rationalised the Studio corpus and added exact same-scope backlink visibility before search delivery. DSI-1 and SM-1 are complete. Their Roadmap concepts and deliveries remain here, while current contracts and durable proposals belong to Docs Viewer Search, Docs Viewer Search Index, Docs Viewer Search Tokenizer, and Docs Viewer Search Relevance outside the Roadmap hierarchy. Catalogue Search remains a separate later mechanics delivery.
